posts.cooked:
This may have come up at some point, and if it did, I apologize for bring it up again.

I mainly play with the Oversized Villain cards when playing SOTM, and I think they're excellent and make the board a lot clearer than playing with the normal villains, which sit on the table and can be hard to read.

That being said, as I've been learning the game, I can't always remember the hero powers, and I feel like having Oversized Heroes would be a net positive to the game. Has there been any thought of making these at some point (even if it's after the last expansion comes out)? Thanks for your time :)

 

-Zak

cmschex wrote:

 Devil's advocate: If they're reprinting the heroes at the end anyway, why not print them oversized? This way, the originals don't lose their value because there's a cheaper "regular-sized" option.

 

Cost, I'd imagine.  The retail on the Oversized Villain Packs is  $15, and an Oversized Hero Pack would be at least twice the number of cards, not to mention the graphic design/overlay.  So I'd expect the MSRP of that to be around that of a full expansion or more and I don't know if the profit margin would be worth it to print it.  Also, the villains almost need the Oversized because they have so much text whereas the heroes just have their power and incaps.
